Partner with business leaders to identify and implement digital solutions, automation and emerging technologies that improve efficiency, employee experience and business outcomes. Strengthen Cybersecurity & Resilience Lead Grok’s cybersecurity strategy, controls, monitoring and incident response. Strengthen security across systems, devices, networks, data and third-party services. Own the technology components of disaster recovery, backup and business continuity. Build cybersecurity awareness across the organisation and proactively respond to emerging threats. Drive Risk, Compliance & Access Management Establish robust identity and access management practices across Grok’s core systems. Support data protection, privacy and technology-related regulatory requirements across our operating markets. Lead technology and cybersecurity risk assessments and support audits, client due diligence and enterprise security requirements. Ensure technology risks are identified, communicated and effectively managed. Optimise Vendors, Investment & Technology Delivery Manage technology vendors, contracts, licences, service levels and key commercial relationships.
